__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

setSyncApiPaused.description: Pause or resume the v6/v7 sync API remote sites sync through, e.g. during central maintenance. Returns the new state.

setProcessorsPaused.description: Pause or resume the transfer and general processors. Resuming triggers each one so the backlog is picked up. Returns the new state.

setMaintenanceMode.description: Turn maintenance mode on or off. On pauses sync, the sync API and processors and signs out every user who is not a server admin. Off is refused while OMS central's own sync buffer has records left to integrate.
